## Summary

The HTTP request parsing was broken due to three intentional off-by-one errors introduced in the codebase:

1. **`/testbed/gunicorn/http/body.py` line 242**: The `readline()` method was searching for newlines starting from index 1 instead of 0 (`data.find(b"\n", 1, size)` → `data.find(b"\n", 0, size)`), causing newlines at the start of buffers to be missed.

2. **`/testbed/gunicorn/http/message.py` line 318**: The `read_line()` method was searching for CRLF sequences starting from index 1 (`data.find(b"\r\n", 1)` → `data.find(b"\r\n")`), causing HTTP request line endings at position 0 to be missed.

3. **`/testbed/gunicorn/http/unreader.py` line 48**: The `read()` method was incorrectly slicing data at `size + 1` instead of `size` (`data[size + 1:]` → `data[size:]`), causing one byte to be dropped on every buffer operation.

All three issues have been fixed and all 260 tests now pass.
